create_Tool_class: create a Tool subclass that wraps an async function and exposes it to the agent
implement_tool_cancellation_handler: implement the _handle_tool_call_cancellation_events method to filter by call_id and cancel relevant tool calls
call_Tool_instance: call a Tool instance as an async callable that yields FunctionResponse objects from the wrapped function
subscribe_tool_to_event_bus: subscribe a Tool to the event bus for TOOL_CALL_CANCELLATION events in the constructor
build_tool_with_async_generator: build a Tool whose wrapped function is an async generator that yields multiple FunctionResponse results
